_about: Written correspondence between PHARM disease labels and PRISM Repurposing 19Q4 cell-line lineages. This file IS the pushout span, made reviewable. A disease absent from this file is REFUSED; no disease may acquire a lineage by string similarity at runtime. Hand-written on 2026-08-14, before any viability data was read.
_default: coproduct - PHARM:<disease> and PRISM:<lineage> stay distinct objects and a candidate is annotated, not identified. A pushout is asserted only where correspondence_type is DIRECT, NEAR or SUPERSET below, and every verdict then names the PRISM lineage rather than the clinical entity.

_correspondence_types.DIRECT: PRISM's subtype label denotes the same clinical entity.
_correspondence_types.NEAR: Closely aligned but not identical; the difference is stated and carried into the verdict.
_correspondence_types.SUPERSET: The PRISM lineage strictly contains the clinical entity. A selectivity result is a statement about the lineage, not the entity.
_correspondence_types.REFUSED: No adjudication surface exists. Never scored, in either direction.

_power_tiers.A: At least 15 cell lines in the target lineage. Eligible for the headline result.
_power_tiers.B: Fewer than 15. Effect size reported with an explicit UNDERPOWERED label, excluded from the headline.
_power_tiers.none: Refused; power is not the reason.

diseases.justification: Every skin line in PRISM 19Q4 carries secondary_tissue 'melanoma'. The lineage and the clinical entity denote the same disease.
diseases.known_discrepancy: Cutaneous, acral and uveal melanoma are not distinguished by this label.

diseases.justification: PRISM's own 'lung_NSC' annotation is a direct non-small-cell label, so this is not the TCGA LUAD+LUSC string join the boundary rules forbid. Small-cell lines (n=11) are excluded by the same column.
diseases.known_discrepancy: A clinical NSCLC indication is not a panel of 90 adherent lines. Adenocarcinoma, squamous and large-cell histologies are pooled and their driver distributions differ, so a pooled selectivity result can be driven by one histology.

diseases.justification: PRISM labels CNS lines 'glioma' without grade. Glioblastoma lines are contained in this set.
diseases.known_discrepancy: Grade II-III gliomas are included and are a different clinical disease with different prognosis and drivers. Medulloblastoma lines (n=2) are excluded by the secondary_tissue filter.

diseases.justification: The pancreas lineage is unsubtyped in 19Q4 and is dominated by ductal adenocarcinoma lines.
diseases.known_discrepancy: Neuroendocrine and acinar pancreatic tumours cannot be separated out; they are biologically distinct from PDAC.

diseases.justification: Direct lineage match; 14 of 35 additionally carry an MSI annotation.
diseases.known_discrepancy: MSI and MSS tumours respond differently to several drug classes and are pooled here.

diseases.justification: Direct lineage match with receptor subtypes annotated (TNBC 12, ERpos 7, HER2Amp 4, TPBC 2).
diseases.known_discrepancy: Receptor subtype governs treatment choice clinically and is pooled here. A pooled result may be driven entirely by the TNBC lines.

diseases.justification: The liver lineage is predominantly hepatocellular. Cholangiocarcinoma sits in a separate 'bile_duct' lineage and is therefore already excluded.
diseases.known_discrepancy: One hepatoblastoma line is present and is excluded by secondary_tissue. Remaining lines are not individually confirmed as HCC.

diseases.justification: PRISM's kidney lineage is essentially unsubtyped (only one line carries a 'renal' secondary label) and contains renal cell carcinoma lines.
diseases.known_discrepancy: Non-RCC kidney tumours such as Wilms may be present, and clear-cell versus papillary RCC cannot be separated. A result here is about 'kidney', not 'RCC'.

diseases.justification: Lineage exists and matches, but with 5 lines (leiomyosarcoma 2, fibrosarcoma 1, pleomorphic 1, undifferentiated 1) a rank-based lineage contrast is underpowered.
diseases.known_discrepancy: Soft-tissue sarcoma is dozens of distinct diseases. The 60-candidate review already found that a broad STS label hid opposite subtype results for ribociclib (R02). Five lines cannot represent that heterogeneity. Reported as UNDERPOWERED_REPORTED, never in the headline.

diseases.justification: Lineage exists; 4 lines is below any threshold at which a lineage contrast is meaningful.
diseases.known_discrepancy: No candidate pair currently reaches this lineage, since the one prostate candidate (R20, clascoterone) was never screened. Recorded for completeness so a future session cannot quietly add it.

diseases.justification: No GIST lineage exists in PRISM 19Q4.
diseases.known_discrepancy: PRISM's 'gastric' lineage is 18 adenocarcinoma lines plus 3 others. GIST is a KIT/PDGFRA-driven mesenchymal tumour of the gut wall - a different cell of origin with different drivers. Identifying GIST with 'gastric' on the shared word 'stomach' is exactly the silent string join that corrupts every edge crossing the seam. Refused.

diseases.justification: PRISM 19Q4 contains no haematological cell lines in either the primary or the secondary screen.
diseases.known_discrepancy: Not repairable by threshold choice. Would require a screen including suspension lines, such as GDSC or CTRP, and its own correspondence document.
AML also has no 'treats' label anywhere in the local graph, so it was already the weakest disease in the candidate set.
Myelofibrosis is a bone-marrow stromal and clonal myeloid disease; a viability screen on adherent tumour lines would not be the right assay even if lines existed.

diseases.justification: No haematological or plasma-cell lineage in PRISM 19Q4.
diseases.known_discrepancy: Myeloma lines are standard in other screens; their absence here is a property of this release, not of the disease.

diseases.justification: A germline cancer-predisposition syndrome, not a tumour indication. There is no lineage to correspond to because there is no tumour type named.
diseases.known_discrepancy: The 60-candidate review already classified all six of these rows EXCLUDE_CATEGORY_ERROR. This refusal is consistent with that verdict and adds nothing new; it is recorded so the refusal is explicit rather than incidental.
